summary: STUDENT PROPERTY AVAILABLE SUMMER 2024 £132.69 MODERN DECOR
description: Student property available summer 2024 at £132.69pppw My Property Box are pleased to bring to the market this large open plan studio designed for two people, with one bedroom and one mezzanine sleeping area. The apartment has been designed throughout with modern fixtures, fittings and furniture and is conveniently situated in the City Centre giving easy access to local amenities as well as Newcastle and Northumbria University, RVI hospital and Eldon Square Shopping Centre as well as Newcastle Business School. To arrange your viewing call at My Property Box and speak to a member of the Lettings Team.
